external_data_policy.scope: Only matching files within the specified directory and its descendants.
external_data_policy.reason: Full externally sourced responses and their full-text derivatives remain analysis-only working data.
external_data_policy.retained: Source metadata, capture receipts, short evidence excerpts, extraction and download scripts.
external_data_policy.availability_limit: Fresh downloads may differ from recorded hashes. Exact offset verification requires the matching full derived text; it cannot be independently repeated from excerpts alone.
